messages:
Nora Patel: Opening a small docs refresh for the Realtime Hello quickstart (websocket path). Goals: make auth CLI-first, add a wscat example showing auth header, tighten minimal deploy, add token rotation note, and fix a broken anchor in the "deploy" section. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5132
Ethan Brooks: Nice. Realtime examples are the main source of confusion for new users. Please add a one-line wscat example like: `wscat -c \"wss://realtime.redwood.ai/v1/connect\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY\"` so folks can test quickly.
Nora Patel: Adding that. Also planning a tiny snippet for long-lived connections: send a ping every 30s and reconnect backoff. Will keep it under an "Advanced" collapsible.
Sam (Docs): UX ask  keep both CLI and env var, but show CLI first. Maybe a "Quick test" block with `redwood login --api-key <KEY>` then a collapsed "CI / env var" with `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` and PowerShell: `$env:REDWOOD_API_KEY="<KEY>"`.
Keiko (DevEx): Also add region init for SDKs for EU customers, e.g. `RedwoodClient(region="eu-west-1")` and a short callout that Realtime endpoints vary by region.
Ethan Brooks: Small migration note: the recommended model alias has changed (`redwood/helium-v1` -> `redwood/helium`). Could we include a safe repo migration hint, plus macOS-safe variant?
Nora Patel: Added two helpers: `git grep -l "helium-v1" | xargs sed -i 's/helium-v1/helium/g'` and macOS: `git grep -l "helium-v1" | xargs sed -i '' 's/helium-v1/helium/g'`. Also included a `perl -pi -e` alternative for folks who prefer that.
Sam (Docs): Watch the wording on limits  previous quickstart text said "no rate limits" which is misleading. Change to: "soft limits apply on free tier; see pricing" and link to the pricing page.
Keiko (DevEx): For Docker base, use `node:18-slim` in the primary example and provide a small Alpine variant as a note. Add a short k8s demo `kubectl run` one-liner under a "DEMO ONLY" label.
Nora Patel: Done. Also added a short token-rotation note: recommend short-lived keys + automated rotation for long-lived websocket apps, link to the security guide.
docs-ci: Preview build queued for PR 5132  (staging preview URL will be posted).
Ethan Brooks: Found a broken anchor in the deploy section during local preview, left a comment on the PR with the failing id.
Nora Patel: Fixed the anchor and pushed a small patch. Also added a troubleshooting curl check for auth: `curl -I -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health` and an explicit line about clock skew causing 401s.
docs-ci: Preview build passed: docs-ci/preview/5132 2705 (staging: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/realtime-hello/preview)
Sam (Docs): Reviewed and left two tiny style nits (heading depth + a phrasing tweak in the rotation note). Once those are fixed we can approve.
Nora Patel: Addressed nits and will merge in the next deploy window. Thanks all! :shipit:
